evidence: src/rebar/review_bot/app.py:224-228: `token = _request_token(request)` / `if cfg.webhook_token and hmac.compare_digest(token, cfg.webhook_token): return True` / `return _is_internal_gerrit_webhook(request, cfg)`
Prior code (diff): `if not cfg.webhook_token or not hmac.compare_digest(token, cfg.webhook_token):` -> 401, which rejected everything when webhook_token was empty.
dropped.finding: The refactor changes the empty-token behavior from fail-closed to a fallthrough. Previously `if not cfg.webhook_token or not hmac.compare_digest(...): return 401` rejected ALL requests when webhook_token was unset/empty. The new `_webhook_authorized` guards the token compare with `if cfg.webhook_token and ...:` and, when webhook_token is empty, falls through to `_is_internal_gerrit_webhook`, so a misconfigured/empty token no longer hard-rejects — requests presenting the (spoofable) origin headers are accepted.
scenarios: WEBHOOK_TOKEN and GERRIT_BOT_TOKEN both unset/empty in the environment: token compare is skipped entirely and acceptance depends only on the spoofable origin-header branch rather than failing closed.
